ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food-web diagram shows organism labels including the blue label "parrotfish" near the lower-left/middle area and the red label "reef sharks" near the top-left. A black arrow goes upward from "parrotfish" toward "reef sharks," with the arrowhead pointing at "reef sharks." Reasoning: In a food-web diagram, arrows indicate the direction energy flows, from the organism that is eaten or energy source to the consumer. Since the arrow points from parrotfish to reef sharks, the energy flows from parrotfish to reef sharks.
